offering_description.value: Virtus offers investment funds and managed accounts to individual investors, financial intermediaries and institutions. Its affiliated investment managers and external subadvisers manage portfolios across equities, fixed income, multi-asset and alternative strategies.

primary_products.value: mutual funds; exchange-traded funds; closed-end funds; collateralized loan obligations

primary_services.value: separately managed accounts; investment subadvisory; fund administration and shareholder services

customer_segment.value: B2C: Individual investors, often through financial advisers; B2B: Wealth managers, broker-dealers, insurers, corporate pension plans, endowments and foundations; B2G: Public pension plans and government retirement systems

end_markets.value: retail investing; wealth management; institutional investing; retirement and pensions; insurance

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Asset-based fees for managing funds and separate accounts or serving as subadviser; service fees: Fund administration, transfer agency and shareholder servicing
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Pools investor capital in funds and allocates it to securities for retail and institutional investors; service provider: Manages portfolios under client mandates and administers funds for investment vehicles and their shareholders

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, with international distribution including Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Equity, fixed-income, multi-asset and alternative strategies across funds and managed accounts

distribution_channels.value: partners / resellers: Broker-dealer platforms, registered investment advisers, banks and wealth management firms; direct sales: Institutional sales teams serving pension plans, insurers and other asset owners; agents / brokers: Institutional investment consultants who help asset owners select managers
distribution_channels.category: partners / resellers; direct sales; agents / brokers

regulatory_exposure.value: high: SEC registration and oversight for investment advisers and registered funds, plus FINRA oversight of broker-dealer distribution

notes: The full country-by-country scope of international distribution is uncertain.
